machines.name: Old Clunky
machines.description: A creaky old machine with just two reels and one payline.

machines.name: Snack Stacker
machines.description: Three rows of snacks, and every payline pays. Pricier spins, much bigger wins.

machines.name: Burrow Bonanza
machines.description: Five reels deep in the burrow. Hamster Wilds, and three Hamster Balls roll in free spins.

machines.name: Pouch Palace
machines.description: Twenty paylines of velvet and gold. Three Cheek Pouches spin the jackpot wheel for a pot.

machines.name: Hamster Maze
machines.description: A maze of tunnels with no paylines: matching snacks on neighbouring reels win on any row. 243 ways to win.

machines.name: Acorn Vault
machines.description: A steel vault full of Golden Acorns. Six or more lock in place and respin for coins: fill it for the Grand.

machines.name: Moving Day
machines.description: Cardboard boxes everywhere! When boxes land, every box opens into the same symbol, so a few boxes can fill whole lines.

machines.name: The Big Cheese
machines.description: A royal wheel of cheese. Every line of five spins the cheese wheel: ×2 to ×10 on that line.

delivery.name: Food Delivery
delivery.description: Your hamster scoots off to deliver seeds. Safe coins, but nobody runs the wheel while it's away.

upgrades.name: Chubby Cheeks
upgrades.description: Stuffs more coins in those cheeks.

upgrades.name: Wheel Training
upgrades.description: Your hamster learns to run the wheel on its own.

upgrades.name: Four-Leaf Clover
upgrades.description: Your hamster found a four-leaf clover. More Luck on every machine: fewer Wood Shavings, more wins.

upgrades.name: High Roller
upgrades.description: Your hamster learns to carry bigger coins. Unlocks the next bet size on every machine.

upgrades.name: Hot Streak
upgrades.description: Wins in a row get your hamster fired up: each one pays a bit more than the last.

upgrades.name: Lucky Pennies
upgrades.description: A jar of lucky pennies by the wheel. Every win you pay for has a chance to pay double.

upgrades.name: Night Shift
upgrades.description: Your hamster works harder while you're away: more coins waiting when you come back.

upgrades.name: Cosy Nest
upgrades.description: A comfier nest, so your hamster keeps running longer while you're away: one more hour each level.

upgrades.name: Running Shoes
upgrades.description: Tiny running shoes: every spin and auto-spin is a little quicker, on every machine.

upgrades.name: Coupon Book
upgrades.description: Clip a coupon: spins on every machine cost 5% less, each level.

upgrades.name: Sticker Album
upgrades.description: Show off the Hamster Diary: +1% payouts for every sticker you've earned, each level.

upgrades.name: Star Polish
upgrades.description: Polish your Machine Stars: each star pays 5% more on its machine, each level.

upgrades.name: Mega Cheeks
upgrades.description: Cheeks so big they need their own postcode: +100% payouts a level, with no limit.

upgrades.name: Zoomies
upgrades.description: Your hamster gets the zoomies! Now and then a paid spin on a five-reel machine has it dash across the reels, turning one to three of them wild.

upgrades.name: Hot Sauce
upgrades.description: A dash of hot sauce: Hot Streak pays 2% more for every win in a row, each level.

upgrades.name: Blazing Streak
upgrades.description: Hot Streak burns longer: it counts one more win in a row each level, so the bonus climbs higher.

upgrades.name: Line Dance
upgrades.description: Every win where all the reels match pays 10% more, each level.

upgrades.name: Rabbit's Foot
upgrades.description: A lucky (toy) rabbit's foot. More Luck on every machine.

upgrades.name: Golden Touch
upgrades.description: Every golden jackpot gives one more Hamster Token, each level.

upgrades.name: Tip Jar
upgrades.description: Customers tip more often: a Hamster Token every 3rd delivery instead of every 5th.

upgrades.name: Card Counter
upgrades.description: The card gamble shows 3 more of the cards that came before. (Every card is still a fresh draw!)

upgrades.name: Deep Pockets
upgrades.description: Every jackpot pot starts 25% bigger, and starts again bigger after it's won, each level.

upgrades.name: Money Bags
upgrades.description: A millionaire's money bags: +50% payouts a level.

upgrades.name: Oiled Lever
upgrades.description: A drop of oil and the old lever takes fewer coins per pull.

upgrades.name: New Seeds
upgrades.description: Paint a new symbol onto Old Clunky's reels: first the Baby Carrot, then the Golden Seed. Bigger prizes, but wins come a little less often.

upgrades.name: Lucky Horseshoe
upgrades.description: A horseshoe nailed above Old Clunky's reels. More Luck on this machine.

upgrades.name: Third Reel
upgrades.description: Bolt a third reel onto Old Clunky.

upgrades.name: Pays Both Ways
upgrades.description: Old Clunky reads its line from the right-hand reel too, so a pair on reels 2 and 3 pays. A full line still pays once.

upgrades.name: Smooth Gears
upgrades.description: Greased gears inside the Snack Stacker. Fewer coins per spin.

upgrades.name: Extra Paylines
upgrades.description: Chalk another winning line across the Snack Stacker: the two diagonals.

upgrades.name: Fourth Reel
upgrades.description: Bolt a fourth reel onto the Snack Stacker. Four in a row pays huge.

upgrades.name: Hamster Wild
upgrades.description: Your hamster's face on the Snack Stacker's reels. It stands in for any snack.

upgrades.name: Snack Restock
upgrades.description: Stock the Snack Stacker with new treats: first the Strawberry, then the Golden Seed. Bigger prizes, but wins come a little less often.

upgrades.name: Lucky Sprinkles
upgrades.description: Rainbow sprinkles in the Snack Stacker's gears. More Luck on this machine.

upgrades.name: Pays Both Ways
upgrades.description: Every Snack Stacker payline pays from the right-hand reel too, as well as from the left. A full line still pays once.

upgrades.name: Tunnel Grease
upgrades.description: Slippery tunnels. The Burrow Bonanza takes fewer coins per spin.

upgrades.name: More Tunnels
upgrades.description: Dig another winding payline through the burrow.

upgrades.name: Bouncy Ball
upgrades.description: A springier Hamster Ball. More free spins every time they start.

upgrades.name: Deeper Digging
upgrades.description: Dig up new treats for the Burrow Bonanza: first the Red Apple, then the Golden Seed. Bigger prizes, but wins come a little less often.

upgrades.name: Lucky Acorn
upgrades.description: A lucky acorn buried under the Burrow Bonanza. More Luck on this machine.

upgrades.name: Pays Both Ways
upgrades.description: Every payline through the burrow pays from the right-hand reel too, as well as from the left. A full line still pays once.

upgrades.name: Ball Bearings
upgrades.description: Smoother Hamster Balls: one more free spin every time free spins start on the Burrow Bonanza, each level.

upgrades.name: Sticky Wilds
upgrades.description: Honey on the paws: a Hamster Wild that lands in free spins stays put for one more free spin, each level.

upgrades.name: Party Climb
upgrades.description: The burrow party gets louder: every free spin pays ×1 more than the last, up to one step higher each level (×2, ×3, ×4, ×5).

upgrades.name: Velvet Gears
upgrades.description: Plush-lined gears. The Pouch Palace takes fewer coins per spin.

upgrades.name: Extra Pouches
upgrades.description: Stitch two more paylines across the Pouch Palace.

upgrades.name: Pouch Polish
upgrades.description: Shiny pouches attract coins. Every jackpot pot grows faster.

upgrades.name: Royal Pantry
upgrades.description: Fill the Pouch Palace's pantry: first the Red Apple, then the Golden Seed. Bigger prizes, but wins come a little less often.

upgrades.name: Lucky Charm
upgrades.description: A golden charm hung over the Pouch Palace's reels. More Luck on this machine.

upgrades.name: Pays Both Ways
upgrades.description: Every Pouch Palace payline pays from the right-hand reel too, as well as from the left. A full line still pays once.

upgrades.name: Maze Map
upgrades.description: A map of every tunnel: each level makes a Hamster Maze spin 10% cheaper.

upgrades.name: Longer Maze
upgrades.description: Another reel of tunnels: 27 ways, then 81, then all 243 ways to win.

upgrades.name: Maze Runner
upgrades.description: Your hamster runs through the maze as a Hamster Wild, on reels 2 to 5. Each level: more wilds.

upgrades.name: Hidden Snacks
upgrades.description: New symbols in the maze: the Strawberry, then the Golden Seed. Bigger prizes, but wins come a little less often.

upgrades.name: Lucky Turns
upgrades.description: Machine Luck for the Hamster Maze: fewer Wood Shavings, more wins.

upgrades.name: Oiled Hinges
upgrades.description: The vault door swings easy: each level makes an Acorn Vault spin 10% cheaper.

upgrades.name: Wider Vault
upgrades.description: Two more paylines on the Acorn Vault each level, up to 20.

upgrades.name: Sticky Paws
upgrades.description: One more respin in hold & spin: to start with, and every time a new acorn lands.

upgrades.name: Vault Pantry
upgrades.description: New symbols in the vault: the Red Apple, then the Golden Seed. Bigger prizes, but wins come a little less often.

upgrades.name: Lucky Combination
upgrades.description: Machine Luck for the Acorn Vault: fewer Wood Shavings, more wins, more acorns.

upgrades.name: Pays Both Ways
upgrades.description: Every Acorn Vault payline pays from the right-hand reel too, as well as from the left. A full line still pays once.

upgrades.name: Acorn Stash
upgrades.description: Hold & spin on the Acorn Vault gets one more respin: to start with, and after every new acorn.

upgrades.name: Cheese Slicer
upgrades.description: Thinner slices: each level makes a Big Cheese spin 10% cheaper.

upgrades.name: Bigger Board
upgrades.description: Two more paylines on the Big Cheese each level, up to 20.

upgrades.name: Aged Cheese
upgrades.description: Stronger cheese: +1 on every wedge of the cheese wheel (×2 becomes ×3, and so on).

upgrades.name: Cheese Board
upgrades.description: New symbols on the Big Cheese: the Golden Seed, then the Cheese Wedge. Bigger prizes, but wins come a little less often.

upgrades.name: Lucky Rind
upgrades.description: Machine Luck for the Big Cheese: fewer Wood Shavings, more wins.

upgrades.name: Pays Both Ways
upgrades.description: Every Big Cheese payline pays from the right-hand reel too, as well as from the left. A full line still pays once (and spins the wheel once).

upgrades.name: Sharp Cheddar
upgrades.description: Every wedge of the cheese wheel gets +1 (x2 becomes x3, and so on).

upgrades.name: Packing Tape
upgrades.description: Taped-up boxes stack faster: each level makes a Moving Day spin 10% cheaper.

upgrades.name: More Rooms
upgrades.description: A bigger new home: two more paylines on Moving Day each level, up to 20.

upgrades.name: Bubble Wrap
upgrades.description: More Moving Boxes land on Moving Day (+2 weight each level). More boxes, more lines filled.

upgrades.name: Valuables
upgrades.description: A new symbol on Moving Day: the Golden Seed (boxes can open into it too). Bigger prizes, but wins come a little less often.

upgrades.name: Lucky Van
upgrades.description: Machine Luck for Moving Day: fewer Wood Shavings, more wins.

upgrades.name: Pays Both Ways
upgrades.description: Every Moving Day payline pays from the right-hand reel too, as well as from the left. A full line still pays once.

nodes.name: Family Pride
nodes.description: Every pup in the family is born with chubby cheeks.

nodes.name: Family Fortune
nodes.description: A bigger seed jar: the Heirloom Seeds you hold can pay more before the jar is full.

nodes.name: Lucky Whiskers
nodes.description: Twitchy whiskers sniff out gold. Some Sunflower Seeds become Golden Seeds.

nodes.name: Carrot Patch
nodes.description: Grandma's secret garden. Some Sunflower Seeds become Baby Carrots.

nodes.name: Jackpot Dance
nodes.description: When every reel matches, the hamster does a happy dance and the win pays extra.

nodes.name: Warm-up Laps
nodes.description: Pups are born knowing how to run the wheel.

nodes.name: Quick Paws
nodes.description: Spins and auto-spins go faster.

nodes.name: Heirloom Reel
nodes.description: The family keeps Old Clunky's third reel.

nodes.name: Speedy Scooter
nodes.description: A zippier scooter. Deliveries are quicker.

nodes.name: Big Backpack
nodes.description: Room for more seeds. Your payout bonuses boost deliveries too.

nodes.name: Self-Starter
nodes.description: When you're out of coins, the hamster heads off on a delivery by itself.

nodes.name: Lucky Family
nodes.description: Every pup is born lucky: more Hamster Luck on every machine.

nodes.name: Lucky Heirlooms
nodes.description: Lucky charms passed down the family: every machine starts with a level of its Machine Luck.

nodes.name: Big Spender
nodes.description: Pups are born with bigger coins: every life starts with a High Roller bet step.

nodes.name: Seed Vault
nodes.description: The family keeps its seed packets: every machine starts with its first symbol unlocked (then both).

nodes.name: Snack Inheritance
nodes.description: The family keeps the Snack Stacker: every pup starts owning it.

nodes.name: Ball Pit
nodes.description: A pit full of Hamster Balls: they land more often on the Burrow Bonanza, so free spins come sooner.

nodes.name: Golden Pouches
nodes.description: Every jackpot pot starts bigger, and starts again bigger after it is won.

nodes.name: Helping Paws
nodes.description: A little helper hamster buys cheap upgrades for you, whenever one costs a tenth of your coins or less. Switch it on or off in the Upgrades tab.

nodes.name: Deep Roots
nodes.description: The older the family, the deeper its roots: +2% payouts for every generation.

nodes.name: Four-Leaf Heirloom
nodes.description: A pressed four-leaf clover, passed down: every pup starts with a level of Four-Leaf Clover (then two).

nodes.name: Penny Jar
nodes.description: The family penny jar: +2% chance a level that a win you pay for pays double.

nodes.name: Moving Boxes
nodes.description: A colony trait: more Moving Boxes on Moving Day (+2 weight each level).

nodes.name: Whisker Wisdom
nodes.description: A colony trait: the next Great Migration (and every Colony Trial) brings 25% more Golden Whiskers each level.

nodes.name: Pack Leader
nodes.description: A colony trait: the family leads the colony. Every payout +50% each level.

nodes.name: Starry Roots
nodes.description: A colony trait: every machine can be rebuilt for one more Machine Star each level.

perks.name: Colony Pride
perks.description: The whole colony cheers: every payout +30% each level, in every life and every colony.

perks.name: Seed Sense
perks.description: The family finds more: +10% Heirloom Seeds each level (every life's seeds).

perks.name: Wise Elders
perks.description: The old hamsters help out: they can retire a hamster by itself when its seeds are ready, plant the cheap traits and start the next life (choose when in the Colony tab).

perks.name: Old Friends
perks.description: Friends from the old colony: every pup starts owning the Burrow Bonanza.

perks.name: Trailblazer
perks.description: Every machine can be rebuilt for one more Machine Star each level.

trials.name: Fresh Start
trials.description: No Family Tree and no heirloom bonus: a pup on its own.

trials.name: Tired Paws
trials.description: No auto-spin: every spin by hand.

trials.name: Rusty Machines
trials.description: Machine Stars don't count (no stars' payouts or Luck).

trials.name: Plain Hamster
trials.description: Nothing worn does anything, and no casino boosts.

diary.name: First Spin
diary.description: Spin the reels for the first time.

diary.name: Line Dancer
diary.description: Win on 3 paylines in a single spin.

diary.name: On Fire
diary.description: Win 5 paid spins in a row on one machine.

diary.name: High Roller
diary.description: Spin with a bet of x10 or more.

diary.name: Double Trouble
diary.description: Win the card gamble 3 times in a row.

diary.name: Card Shark
diary.description: Guess the suit of a gamble card.

diary.name: Free Ride
diary.description: Roll 3 Hamster Balls for free spins.

diary.name: Golden Moment
diary.description: Line up Golden Seeds on every reel (3 reels or more).

diary.name: Shooting Star
diary.description: Rebuild a machine for a Machine Star.

diary.name: A-maze-ing
diary.description: Win on 50 ways at once with one symbol in the Hamster Maze.

diary.name: Nut Hoarder
diary.description: Fill every cell of the Acorn Vault in hold & spin (the Grand).

diary.name: The Big Cheese
diary.description: Land a ×10 wedge on the cheese wheel.

diary.name: Whole Arcade
diary.description: Own all seven machines at once.

diary.name: Lucky Number
diary.description: Win on a single number at Hamster Roulette.

diary.name: Blackjack!
diary.description: Get a blackjack at the hamster dealer's table.

diary.name: Photo Finish
diary.description: Win the Hamster Derby on Wobbles, the long shot.

diary.name: Edge of the Board
diary.description: Drop a seed into an edge bin at Seed Drop.

diary.name: Prize Winner
diary.description: Buy something at the casino's Prize Counter.

diary.name: Seeing Double
diary.description: Get a win paid double by Lucky Pennies.

diary.name: Night Owl
diary.description: Come back to coins your hamster earned while you were away.

diary.name: Little Helper
diary.description: Let the Hamster Helper buy an upgrade for you.

diary.name: New Horizons
diary.description: Make the Great Migration to a new colony.

diary.name: Far, Far Away
diary.description: Make the Great Migration three times.

diary.name: Wise Old Hamster
diary.description: Let the Wise Elders retire a hamster for you.

diary.name: Box Full
diary.description: Open five Moving Boxes in one spin on Moving Day.

diary.name: Grand Opening
diary.description: Open the Family Casino (it opens in your second colony).

diary.name: Full Floor
diary.description: Put a cabinet of every machine on the Family Casino's floor.

diary.name: Casino Mogul
diary.description: Bank a million Takings from the Family Casino's till.

prizes.name: Golden Hour
prizes.description: Every machine pays +50% for a while.

prizes.name: Turbo Wheel
prizes.description: The hamster runs faster: spins take 20% less time for a while.

prizes.name: Lucky Charm
prizes.description: +15 Luck on every machine for your next paid spins.

prizes.name: Token Bag
prizes.description: A Hamster Token for the Capsule Machine.

prizes.name: Dealer's Visor
prizes.description: A green dealer's visor for the hamster. Only at the casino.

prizes.name: Tuxedo
prizes.description: A smart black-and-white coat. Only at the casino.

prizes.name: Casino Night
prizes.description: The cage in red velvet and gold. Only at the casino.

upgrades.name: Neon Sign
upgrades.description: A big pink sign out front: +20% guests each level.

upgrades.name: Plush Carpet
upgrades.description: Soft red carpet, swirly and warm: +15% guests each level.

upgrades.name: High-Limit Room
upgrades.description: A velvet-roped room for big spenders: guests bet +25% each level.

upgrades.name: Floor Manager
upgrades.description: A sharp-eyed hamster in a waistcoat: the guests win back 1% less each level.

upgrades.name: Cashier
upgrades.description: Someone to mind the till: it holds 2 more hours of takings each level.

rewards.name: Chip Crate
rewards.description: 500 Casino Chips for the Prize Counter.

rewards.name: Token Box
rewards.description: A Hamster Token for the Capsule Machine.
